decision_study.notes: ADR-0205 development screen only. Select exactly 20 evenly spaced identities after lexicographic symbol/quote-date/expiry ordering per symbol; every selected identity has weight 1/20, and no result selects a feature or model. The full 18,616-row archive would exceed the declared 100,000-chain-row bound, so this fixed 60-entry diagnostic records local-score counts only. Date-only ETF quotes define an after-date-close, indicative and non-executable clock. Raw GridCurve archives are required for atom-aware spread diagnostics. Coarse and half-step weighted scores must meet the declared tolerance and retain the identical model ranking.
